title: Low-Carb Pork Al Pastor Tacos
description: A delicious keto twist on traditional Mexican street food, featuring slow-cooked pork in a spicy tomato-based sauce, served in tacos with fresh cilantro and a sprinkle of queso fresco.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, and spicy taco seasoning.
Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork shoulder in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir in chopped cilantro.
Warm tortillas according to your preference.
Assemble tacos by spooning the pork mixture onto a tortilla and topping with crumbled queso fresco.
